answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a measured tone, citations in parentheses register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Reaching the karst of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The garden holds work receipts rather than names, so the zenith of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
